title: Rev1.4.3 Semantic Completion

compatibility.policy: Rev1.4.3 changes persisted Investigation shape by adding conclusion; Session/Queue advance to r1.4.3 and older state is rejected without aliases or migration.

architecture.main: Sole semantic authority. It may answer directly, use capabilities, keep optional Investigation/Tasks, ask for blocking input, or stop; Runtime does not classify requests or prescribe strategy.
architecture.runtime: Physical/contract authority. Executes capabilities, persists valid state and reports factual rejection/availability state without prescribing the next semantic move.
architecture.grounded_completion: Final is accepted without a second LLM only when Main-owned open commitments are resolved and every Material coordinate explicitly committed by established Investigations or grounded completed Tasks is preserved in Final grounding_ids.
architecture.observation: Generic physical boundary containing domain-neutral mat-* Material (`locator`, `content_hash`, optional opaque `source_version`), mechanically validated Coverage, public fr-* Frontiers, and Runtime-private shared snapshots/lightweight continuation cursors. Snapshot payload is stored once and only requested slices are copied during pagination. Observation contains no public-capability or filesystem-specific extraction, freshness, identity or continuation logic.
architecture.memory: Persistent cognitive state owned semantically by Main and physically by the Memory Kernel. SQLite stores revisioned Memory Nodes, tags, relations, atomic ChangeSets, append-only history and opaque continuation snapshots. Bounded MemoryView uses MemoryCoverage/MemoryFrontier distinct from Observation contracts; no memory body is injected automatically.
architecture.tasks: Optional Main-owned intentional commitments. completion_criteria defines what Main chose to accomplish; result records what Main considers achieved. Runtime enforces shape/closure only after Main creates a Task.
architecture.investigation: Optional Main-owned epistemic commitments. established requires real Material plus Main-authored conclusion stating what the grounding establishes about the goal; Runtime does not judge semantic sufficiency.
architecture.capabilities: Every public registry entry owns execution plus identity/memoization, Material, canonical Coverage/Frontier, continuation/freshness, normalization and public/model projection hooks. Generic dispatch contains no capability-name branches. One effect=observe|execute|mutate field replaces redundant category/effects metadata.
architecture.verification_future: Consolidated future direction only: capability-owned deterministic or specialist-LLM validators may evaluate explicit domain criteria and return physical results through normal Observation. Rev1.4 adds no validator framework or replacement universal gate.
architecture.writes: Real patch transactions target only the dedicated workspace. Eyle self-source is read-only to direct capabilities; self-change experiments run only in an isolated sandbox copy and can leave the sandbox only as an inert ZIP artifact.
architecture.workspace: The automatic work plane is always base_dir/workspace, even when empty. The Eyle installation is a separate Runtime-private self-source available to observational capabilities and isolated self-sandbox execution only.
architecture.self_change: Main may inspect source=eyle and may experiment on run_command(source=eyle), but no capability promotes modified self files. export_sandbox_zip exports only the current isolated snapshot as a non-overwriting ZIP beside Eyle for later human use.
architecture.sandbox: Physical execution backend boundary. run_command defaults to the dedicated user workspace; source=eyle creates an isolated writable copy of Eyle source with live workspace/memory/context state omitted. One sandbox source persists per physical job and source switching fails closed. Microsandbox 0.6.8 uses bind_mount on Linux/macOS and guest_fs_copy on native Windows; guest ZIP exports use Sandbox.fs.copy_to_host. Real workspace and real Eyle source are never mounted or copied back writable.
architecture.transport: LLM transport records physical request start separately from preflight, preserves backend failure status such as read_timeout/model_output_truncated, and uses the real ExecutionContext for stream eligibility/progress. Structured response validation remains fail-closed.
architecture.observation_projection: Canonical Observation remains complete in Runtime state while Main receives fresh deltas, Investigation-pinned coordinates, open Frontiers and a bounded Material directory. Cached replays return coordinates plus short recall excerpts instead of rematerializing full prior payloads.
architecture.model_window: Current llama-server physical context ceiling is 38000 tokens per Main call. The task-wide physical token fuse remains capped at 90000. Rev1.4 has no Claim call and no downstream Claim reserve.
architecture.semantic_freedom: Fixed model-facing text exposes paths, physical facts and contract boundaries without turning workspace state, tools, Tasks or Investigation into prerequisites. Direct Final is a first-class path.
architecture.epistemic_clarity: Main distinguishes retained conversation, persistent Memory, available capabilities and current Runtime Observation/Material by epistemic role. Capability metadata and Memory are context, not proof of current external state; inference is not presented as newly observed fact.
architecture.semantic_completion: Observation exposes reality; Investigation.conclusion records what Main believes that grounding establishes; Task.result records what Main believes was achieved against completion_criteria. Only open Investigation Material remains prompt-pinned; established conclusions become semantic compression while canonical Material and Final grounding continuity remain Runtime-owned.
